pairs.why: Near-identical stars, but B's gold face is shaded more softly, like the real cards, while A's highlights are harder and more chrome-like, close to the 'statue' look.
B's gold has a softer, more satin glow that matches the real cards' smooth lighting; A's rim and ball highlights are slightly hotter and harder.
The two stars are almost identical in shape, finish and light, with no difference that matters for matching the real cards.
B's inner face is a smoother, gently domed satin gold like the soft real props; A reads slightly more like polished hard metal.
B's lighting is softer and more even across the star, closer to the soft-lit real props; A has stronger glare on the face.
B's slightly matte gold and softer bevel come closer to the real cards' soft finish than A's brighter, glossier metal.
Nearly the same, but B's softer specular highlights fit the real cards better than A's slightly glossier, statue-like gold.
B has a gentler satin gold and smoother shading, closer to the real cards; A's highlights are a bit stronger and harder.
